title: Two operator mixes whose grouping a reader misreads warn, and a fix-all applies only the parentheses that keep the meaning
scope:
a compiler warning for a closed list of operator mixes, the help and fix two existing errors carry for
the same misreading, and which suggestions an editor's fix-all may apply. Novis's precedence table is
unchanged, and so is every program's behaviour.

summary.headline: The compiler warns where operator order is easy to misread
summary.body:
`$n ?? 0 + 10` is `$n ?? (0 + 10)`, and `"n=" . $ok ? "x" : "y"` tests the whole
`"n=" . $ok`. Both are valid code, so the compiler warns with `W1022` and does not stop. The
warning offers two fixes: parentheses that keep what the line does now, which a save may apply,
and the order the line most likely meant, which only you can choose. Nothing changes when the
program runs.
